data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 茶罐里的标签
data.description: 她从架子上取下一只茶罐，把标签从头读到尾，笑着问店主这款茶的名字是谁取的。
data.action: 拿起一只茶罐阅读标签
data.camera: 中近景，茶罐和标签可见
data.promptProse: In an aromatic tea merchant's apothecary lined with floor-to-ceiling wooden apothecary drawers, Ho'olheyak lifts a painted lacquer tea tin, reading the calligraphic herbal description with curious delight. Sunbeams piercing through vintage window glass illuminate floating dried tea leaves, weighing scales, and ceramic jars in a rich, sensory-laden boutique.
